accessibility.contrast: Ensure white text on maroon/navy meets WCAG AA standards. Use text-slate-900 for high-contrast body.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid (e.g., data-testid='add-to-cart-button')

instructions_to_main_agent: Use pure HTML and Tailwind CSS for the marketing layout and hero sections. Do NOT use Shadcn Card component for product layouts to ensure maximum layout freedom.
Use Shadcn Sheet for the Slide-out cart.
Use Shadcn Dialog for the Login/Register modals.
Use Lucide React for icons (e.g., ShoppingBag, Search, User, Menu).
Set font-family for body to 'Outfit' and headings to 'Cormorant Garamond'. Remember to import them from Google Fonts in index.css.
WhatsApp Checkout button MUST be prominent with the brand green color #25D366.
Implement a mobile-first responsive design. The grid should be 1 column on mobile, transitioning to 3 columns on large screens.
